window_turn: About 5 minutes, keyboard only. The window was left in another judge's state: light scheme, lesson and Midterm 2 plan side by side, plan changes marked. ⌘K opened a clean palette with a key shown on every command (Hint ⌘⇧H, Sure ⌥1, Edit the plan as text ⌘E, and so on). Typing 'font' listed eight faces (no Charter), 'scheme' gave light and dark, and 'size' gave Size 14 to 22. ⌘, opened Settings as a plain-text file in a tab. Picking 'Size 21' in ⌘K resized every page at once and rewrote 'size = 21' in the settings file. I set it back to 17. ⌘L returned to the lesson, and Tab scrolled to the open task with the caret in it. I typed TEACH: it was handed in as an answer and shown truthfully as 'No mark', and a task was posed. 'b = -5' then came back 'Right' in the gutter from the record. Esc, then 'by the way, why is the t distribution wider than the normal?' was answered with nothing marked, and Tab put the caret back in the open task. ⌘P with 'plan' found 'Midterm 2 plan · Study/midterm-2/plan.md'. ⌘\ merged the two panes into tabs, with the tab row listing Sampling distributions, Settings, Record and Midterm 2 plan. ⌘L brought the lesson back with the caret in the task. Typing latency measured 17 ms median and 19 ms p95. I could do everything without the mouse. One caveat: for about a minute capture.sh returned stale frames while the drive's text showed the new content, so I checked those steps by text, not by photo. I left the window on a single pane showing the lesson.
